camel_example: aliyun esa ListRewriteUrlRules --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234567890000 --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --ConfigId 352816096980000 --ConfigType global --SiteVersion 0 --RuleName rule_example
description_en: Queries the list of URL rewrite configurations for a site
description_zh: 查询站点重写URL配置列表
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-rewrite-url-rules --site-id 1234567890000 --config-id 352816096980000 --config-type global --rule-name rule_example --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --site-version 0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRewriteUrlRules

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
The configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global configurations or rule configurations. Valid values:
global: queries global configurations.
rule: queries rule configurations.

This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, both global and rule configurations are returned. This parameter takes effect only when the functionName parameter is specified
parameters.help_zh:
配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者规则配置，取值范围：
global：查询全局配置；
rule：查询规则配置；

该参数可以不传，不传时不区分全局或者规则配置。此参数只有在传了functionName参数时才会生效
parameters.name: config_type

parameters.help_en: The rule name. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The page number for a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. The default value is version 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version
